elena: quick note 10: after promoting lotus13b int6 to dedicated canary we're seeing intermittent "kv cache full" warnings on long conversations (>1200 context). Leads to slow tail and occasional soft OOMs (recovered).

omar: Is this the same slot-fragmentation pattern we saw on zenith13b? Any correlation with batch pacing or warmstart?

elena: Not exactly. Differences: 1) int6 model shard size is slightly larger due to alignment padding, 2) default generation.max_new_tokens still 256, 3) we enabled aggressive prefetch for canary to improve throughput.

tj: Logs? small sample?

elena: paste from node logs:
```
[2026-03-21 14:02:12] WARN kv_manager: cache_pressure=0.78, free_slots=12
[2026-03-21 14:02:12] WARN allocator: slab_fragmentation=0.42, fallback_alloc=true
[2026-03-21 14:02:13] ERROR generation: soft_oom_recovered, latency_penalty=0.6s
```

perf-bot: Canary metrics: lotus13b-int6 -> 7% traffic; soft_oom_rate=0.9% (baseline int8 0.1%); p99 latency +120ms vs int8.

omar: Hypothesis: prefetch + larger aligned int6 segments push slab into fragmentation under long-kv-usage patterns. Two quick mitigations: A) cap prefetch.window=1 or disable for this model, B) lower generation.max_new_tokens=128 for model default.

tj: Also try `kv.evict_policy=oldest_first` on canary to reduce stray large KV chunks sticking around. We have a feature flag for model-scoped evict policy.

elena: Running three bench variants now (short conv, long conv, mixed):
```
./bench/conv_bench --model=lotus13b --quant=int6 --prompt "short" --max_new_tokens=64 --iters=500
./bench/conv_bench --model=lotus13b --quant=int6 --prompt "long" --max_new_tokens=256 --iters=300
./bench/conv_bench --model=lotus13b --quant=int6 --mixed=true --iters=400
```

omar: Good. Also capture slab histograms and allocator traces (use `--alloc-trace=1`).

ci-bot: Build 2026.03.21-int6-lotus deployed to canary group at 6132467000. Metric alert created @6132467900 for soft_oom_rate.

elena: Early bench (100 iters): short prompt p50=38ms, long conv p50=210ms p95=410ms with soft_ooms. When I disabled kv.prefetch p95 for long conv dropped to 320ms and soft_ooms reduced to 0.2%.

omar: That points at prefetch ordering again. For next steps: 1) roll model-default `kv.prefetch=false` for lotus13b-int6 2) add model override `generation.max_new_tokens=128` 3) Run overnight soak with `slab.reserve_mb=24` and `kv.evict_policy=oldest_first` enabled to see if fragmentation remediates.

tj: Also run a quick quality check comparing int6 vs int8 on our eval set at max_new_tokens=128 to make sure truncating default doesn't hide regressions. Use eval id `eval/lotus-int6-20260321`.

elena: I'll open the PR for model defaults and schedule the soak. Linking perf traces and alloc dumps to the ticket: https://phab/RI-9876.

omar: If soak looks good we can promote changes to dedicated. Leaving follow-up: check any perf delta for the low-latency cohort after the default change.

elena: Thanks. I'll post soak results by tomorrow morning. :mag:
